claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a white vertical console with a PlayStation logo; Photo 1 shows the same console design.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a white and black game controller in front of the console.
No game disc or case appears in either photo.
Only a bagged coiled cable is visible; the full set of accessories is not shown.

risks.risk: Console does not power on or function
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the home screen with the power indicator on

risks.risk: Controller buttons, sticks, or battery do not work
risks.proof: Video of the controller navigating the console or a button-test clip

risks.risk: Console is the digital edition with no disc drive
risks.proof: Clear photo of the front disc slot or model label showing the disc edition
risks.if_unproven: priced as digital edition; a disc game would be unusable

risks.risk: Included cables are incomplete or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of all cables (HDMI, power) and a clip of them connected and working

risks.risk: Age or usage history is unknown with possible heavy wear
risks.proof: Close-up photos of wear, the serial number, and original receipt if available
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used with no warranty

proof_requests: Video of the PS5 booting to the home screen
Video of the controller working with the console
Photo of the front of the console showing the disc drive slot
Photo of all included cables and the FIFA disc or game case
Photo of the console serial number and proof of purchase if available
response.reason: The witness identifies a Sony PlayStation 5 with a controller, so the item can be priced at its worst case; the seller's game and accessory claims are unproven and would raise the price if verified.
